name: 'ARTIST MACHINE'
description:
ARTIST MACHINE (2023)

My main goal was to adapt the concept of Japanese Vending Machine to the popular and iconic artists on Twitter while creating this piece. 

Note: The artists I chose were the ones that came to my mind first. 

It was very generous of them to give me their permission. I do not want any of my friends to be offended.All the price tags and the iconic words in the piece were for fun. It does not reflect reality.

My top 10 collectors that have my pieces will get an ed. airdrop of 'ARTIST MACHINE' per each.

Once the OE of ARTIST MACHINE ends, the 5 people that hold the most will be sent the ARTIST MACHINE print framed and signed by Gruff.

For the art, for the culture.
